tests.name: Appilix registration + turn-on-notifications card
tests.reason: Both behaviours only run inside the Appilix native WebView (window.appilix bridge). The staging browser suite cannot emulate that bridge, and registering a device token is a write, which staging (production Supabase) must never do. These Vitest suites prove the three Appilix registration paths never call the plain user-agent registration, browsers keep it, and the card's visibility matrix; the standard community-app smoke run confirms the deployed shell and the notifications panel still load in a browser, where the card is hidden by design.
